CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  MINUTES
  Regular Meeting
  November 9, 2021

  •  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:30 P.M. via video conference and teleconference

  •  ROLL CALL:
  Present: Ankit Udani, Stanley Tsai, Nora Hernandez, Michael Daninger
  •  Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza
  Staff Present: Richard Abe AIA, Erin Ung, Vist Yang

CONSENT AGENDA

There were six (11) records of meeting minutes on the consent calendar.
MOTION:
  •  Hernandez made the motion to approve the consent agenda.
  •  The second was by Daninger.
  •  The motion was carried unanimously.

DISCUSSION AGENDA:

ITEM 12:
APPLICANT: 1416 Sarazen Drive

Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval as submitted.

The applicant Janetha Giordano was present for Item number 12 and the staff report was given.
There were no public comments and there were no comments submitted by email prior to the
meeting.

Hernandez had no comments.
Tsai had no comments.
Daninger had no comments.
Udani had no comments and called for a motion.

MOTION:
 •  Daninger moved to approve the application as submitted.

  1
   •  The second was by Hernandez.
  •  The motion carried 4-0 with the following roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai, Michael Daninger
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

ITEM 13:
APPLICANT: 1420 South 3rd Street
Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval as submitted.

The applicant Kamen Lai was present for Item number 13 and the staff report was given.
There were no public comments and there were no comments submitted by email prior to the
meeting.

Tsai stated that he appreciated the new design and had questions about the location of the
condensers units due to the roof slope. The applicant stated that the condenser units will not be on
roof and will work with staff on the location of the condenser units.

Daninger agreed with the location of the units being on the ground and questioned if the water
heaters will be tankless and if so what would be their location. The applicant stated the water
heaters would be tankless and will be installed indoors.

Hernandez was also concerned regarding the tight spaces for equipment.

Udani concurred with the overall comments including the location of the condensers.

Udani called for a motion.

MOTION:
 •  Nora Hernandez moved to approve the application with the following conditions:
  1. Plans shall be updated to show all utility equipment and limit their visibility from street;
  2. No equipment shall be located on the roof;
  3. Revised drawings shall be reviewed and approved by DRB staff; and
  4. MWELO compliant documents shall be provided at time of building plan check.
 •  The second was by Stanley Tsai
 •  The motion carried 4-0 by the following roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai, Michael Daninger
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

  2
 ITEM 14:
APPLICANT: 632 South Chapel Avenue
Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval with the condition that all existing
site walls shall be documented on the drawings.

The applicant Marino Vega-Paez was present for Item number 14 and the staff report was given.
There were no public comments and no comments submitted by email prior to the meeting.

Hernandez questioned if the stucco finish on the rest of house will be repainted or/or sand blasted.
The applicant stated that the entire house will be painted with the Indigo color and the finish is in
stucco. The general contractor shall determine whether it will be sand blasted or not.

Daninger had no comments.

Tsai questioned if the applicant had made any changes to the entry roof condition due to the
discrepancies between the photos and elevations. The applicant stated that there are no changes on
exterior roof condition at the entry. The main scope of the work is repainting the house and
refinishing the wood accent trim where it is necessary. Tsai was concerned that the Indigo color
choice might be unsuitable contextually due to the contrast compared to the neighbor. The
applicant stated the color was chosen by the client. Tsai also questioned whether some windows
may not be egress compliant. The applicant stated that all non-egress compliant windows will be
replaced with complaint windows.

Udani concurred with the overall comments including the color comments and would like to see
other options than indigo blue and Daninger concurred.

Abe stated the staff work with the applicant on the exact color specification to avoid high
saturation.

Udani called for a motion.

MOTION:
 •  Stanley Tsai moved to approve the application with the following conditions:
  1. The applicant shall work with DRB staff on the color specification of the stucco;
  2. Drawings shall be updated to include all specifications prior to building plan check; and
  3. Revised drawings shall be reviewed and approved by DRB staff.
 •  The second was by Nora Hernandez
 •  The motion carried 4-0 by the following roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai, Michael Daninger
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

  3
 ADJOURNMENT:
MOTION:
 •  Nora Hernandez moved to adjourn the meeting at 8:00
 •  Seconded by Michael Daninger.
 •  The motion carried 4-0 by the following roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

PASSED, APPROVED AND ADOPTED this 14th day of December, 2021.

  _____________________________
  Ankit Udani, Chairman

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary/City Architect
